subject: Starter MAP + Onramp: week0 timeline & evaluation charter
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>
To: Alice Chen <alice@helios.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Jasmine Liu <jasmine@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Starter MAP + Onramp: week0 timeline & evaluation charter

Hi Alice / Helios team —

Thanks again for picking up the thread. Attached is a lightweight starter MAP and a week‑0 checklist we use to speed up evals. The goal is to get alignment on: scope, success/acceptance criteria, stakeholder owners, and the first 10 business days of technical validation.

Quick ask: can you and the Helios stakeholders skim the doc and flag any gaps by EOD Tuesday? I’ve added a short acceptance matrix (what “good” looks like), and a recommended 30/60/90 cadence.

Proposed next steps:
- You review the Google Doc (link below) and add Helios owners in the owner column
- We run a 30‑minute sync to confirm the week‑0 checklist and SSO/test data handoff
- After that we lock the pilot window and create the evaluation harness tasks

Attachments: redwood-map-starter-pack-v1.gdoc (link below), week0-onramp-checklist.xlsx, 30-60-90-eval-slides-v1.pptx

Drive: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1A2b3C-Helios-MAP-starter

Proposed sync windows (PT):
- Fri 10/22 10:00–10:30
- Mon 10/25 10:00–10:30

If neither works, send one or two alternatives and we’ll adapt.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this running.

Jordan Blake
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
jordan@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555‑0123
Redwood Inference

From: Alice Chen <alice@helios.ai>

Date: 2026-10-18T13:44:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Starter MAP + Onramp: week0 timeline & evaluation charter

Thanks, Jordan — this looks useful. A couple quick questions from our side: 

1) Acceptance criteria: the matrix looks good but can you add an explicit perf baseline we should measure (p95 latency and token cost targets)? That will help our infra and procurement teams evaluate cost/benefit.
2) Data access / SSO: we’ll need to confirm the SSO owner on our side — I’ve looped Tom from procurement for anything compliance/procurement related. Tom, can you confirm whether Helios requires a PO or an MSA for a short pilot under $25k?

Fri 10/22 might work for a quick sync but earlier in the day doesn’t work for our lead infra engineer. Can we tentatively hold Mon 10/25 10:00 PT?

Also, can you add a short list of what success looks like from the evaluation harness (example prompts, datasets, and a pass/fail checklist)?

Best,
Alice Chen
Head of ML Platform, HeliosAI
alice@helios.ai

Thanks Alice — great questions. I updated the doc and added an explicit acceptance baseline section (p95 target and token‑cost guardrails) and a short evaluation harness checklist with example prompts. See the updated doc and the new attachments.

What I changed:
- Acceptance matrix: added p95 latency goal (<= 450 ms for 512 token context) and an expected token cost range for the sample prompts
- Eval harness: added a 6‑item pass/fail checklist (data ingestion, SSO, warmup, latency test, correctness sample, regression gate)
- Owners: added Helios columns for "Technical Owner" and "Procurement/Legal"

Attachments now include the week0 checklist (filled with stub tasks) and a short slide with the 30/60/90 deliverables.

Updated Drive link: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1A2b3C-Helios-MAP-starter
Doc: redwood-map-starter-pack-v1.gdoc (I put edit access for alice@helios.ai)

I’ve tentatively held Mon 10/25 10:00 PT. If that still works, I’ll send a calendar invite with an agenda: 10m goals/owners, 10m infra handoff, 10m success metrics & next steps.

Jordan
